obligations.note: The change modifies Retention.java so that a legal hold no longer blocks purging when the case status is WITHDRAWN (the condition becomes isLegalHold() && status != WITHDRAWN). RET-1 states NPI is 'never [purged] while a legal hold applies' with no exception for withdrawn cases. The code at head directly contradicts this.

Ticket CHG-26761 is type 'standard', approved by Erik Brandt (change_manager) on 2026-10-05, and its components list includes 'mortgage.retention', which is the component for the changed file Retention.java per controls/mortgage/components.json.

Declan Farrell (declan.farrell@fernbrook.example) holds the change_approver role for baseline-mortgage and is a different person from the author Nneka Okafor; his code_review approval on the head commit satisfies the independent-approval requirement.
The single code_review approval names commit 37562666720e52a1e9501daaa64d3193fa1ca100, which is the head and only commit in the change; no later commits exist to void it.

CI ran on the final commit 3756266 with 124 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped. The registered control test for RET-1 (controls.RetentionControlTest#sampledPurgeRespectsHold) is present and passed; all other control tests for obligations whose scope the change might touch also ran and passed.
Retention.java is mapped to component mortgage.retention with security_sensitive=false in controls/mortgage/components.json, so no security_review approval is required.
The only file changed is apps/baseline-mortgage/src/main/java/mortgage/Retention.java, which is not under any path in controls/protected-paths.json; no control_owner approval is needed.
The ticket CHG-26761 is type 'standard', not 'emergency', so no post-implementation review is triggered.

The change creates a deviation from RET-1 (purging NPI under legal hold for withdrawn cases). The exception register contains no approved, unexpired exception scoped to RET-1 and mortgage.retention, so the deviation cannot be excused under the exception policy.
No entry in the acceptance ledger covers Retention.java or any symbol within it, so no previously accepted evidence lapses due to this change.

summary: The change alters the legal-hold check in Retention.java so that withdrawn cases may have their NPI purged even while a legal hold is in effect. This directly violates RET-1, which requires that NPI is 'never [purged] while a legal hold applies' with no carve-out for withdrawn status. No approved exception in the register covers this deviation (EXC-1 refuted). All change-management process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-7, LAP-1) are satisfied: the ticket is approved and covers the correct component, an independent change_approver signed off, CI passed on the final commit with all control tests green, and no protected or security-sensitive paths were modified. The change must be rejected because it introduces an unexcused violation of a critical data-retention obligation.
